Intel (INTC) vs Apple (AAPL): on the same formula, their operating margins are 37.2 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — INTC: $52.9B · AAPL: $478.8B
• Revenue growth — INTC: −0.5% · AAPL: +15.1%
• Operating margin — INTC: −4.2% · AAPL: 33.0%
• Net margin — INTC: −0.5% · AAPL: 27.6%
• Free cash flow margin — INTC: −9.4% · AAPL: 28.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — INTC: −9.6% · AAPL: 5.0%

Different fiscal years: INTC Dec 27, 2025 · AAPL Sep 26, 2026. The periods are not identical.
